name: reaper-daemon
description: REAPER MCP server: let Claude read your session, set FX, write automation and measure mix moves.
long_description:
Connects Claude to an existing Reaper Daemon install. Reaper Daemon drives REAPER over a local file bridge with no network port: read every plugin and parameter, set FX values, write automation, and verify a mix move with before and after measurements. Every change runs inside a REAPER undo block.

Install Reaper Daemon first (git clone https://github.com/wretcher207/reaper-daemon, then python3 setup/install.py, then restart REAPER), and point this extension at that folder.

install_dir.title: Reaper Daemon folder
install_dir.description: The folder you cloned Reaper Daemon into (it contains reaper_mcp.py).
